label: Infinite modal-carrier probability underdetermination
summary: Analyst derivation, attribution deferred. Reuses Kripke.Frame/Holds, Mathlib measures, existing finite FineTuningSelection and FineTuningEvidence boundaries. Proofs: no uniform point masses (constant zero sums to zero, constant nonzero to infinity); equal cardinality with unequal mass and modal freedom on a fixed Kripke frame both reuse the shared interior-mass lemma of #2143 (arbitraryInteriorMass, cb2b9ac7), which replaced this draft's duplicate geometric-mixture lemma; a two-vs-three partition obstruction already under finite additivity, incompatible full enumeration limits, and restricted Lebesgue measure. Reject the leap from equal cardinality or modal access to equal probabilities; also reject the leap from absence of a universal uniform prior to impossibility of justified probabilistic inquiry. Positive rival: an independently motivated generative law, measurable geometry or observer-weighting kernel selects a measure without requiring all-permutation invariance. Repair 2026-11-28: all seven remaining results build, bind and pass Comparator and NanoDa; the modal freedom statement now uses the shared InteriorRate and real-valued event mass. Scope: these are non-identification and impossibility-of-symmetric-measure results. No uniform or all-permutation-invariant probability exists on these carriers, but that is not the absence of every probability: point-positive non-uniform measures exist for every interior value. Symmetry: NoUniform and the permutation results are the formal core of the normalizability objection to indifference priors over unbounded or countably infinite ranges. They bind design-side likelihoods the same way: a design hypothesis that assigns equal point masses over a countably infinite range, or a probability invariant under every permutation of an infinite range, has no normalized assignment to use (translation invariance on a continuous unbounded range is a further case not formalized here), and a design likelihood needs a warranted non-uniform measure just as a naturalistic one does. Independent review 2026-11-28 (e87a24fc9): Lean matched its types and nothing was smuggled. Findings and repairs: the modal restatement is now documented as equivalent in value form (for a probability measure, p : ENNReal with 0 < p < 1 and measure s = p is equivalent to an InteriorRate p with real measure s = p); its truth-class hypotheses were further weakened from infinite to nonempty, so it implies the draft. modalProbabilityFreedom is relabelled (admit every interior event probability) and registered as a corollary taking the shared interior-mass statement (c3f76aea) as its premise; its proof only applies that premise, so it is a transcription (instance of c3f76aea), which closes only through the closed premise. ContinuousControl has its own blocker as a positive control. HasDensity is now Mathlib Filter.Tendsto, and PointFullSupport, InteriorRate, NormalizedAdditive, frequency, Exhaustion and HasDensity live in the neutral Logic.CarrierProbability module (on #2143), so the Modal vocabulary no longer imports Science.FineTuningInformation. The four senses of probability (measure, signed finitely additive function, limiting frequency, observer-conditioned likelihood) are recorded in the probability-assignment disambiguation (4d54ff26) and tagged on the statements, with no new bridge between senses.
blocker: Physical world-to-measure, observer-selection and actual designer bridges remain open; independent semantic challenge is pending.
